result_summary.title: Report Builder audit log gaps detected
result_summary.description: I'm seeing gaps in our audit logs when using the Report Builder tool in our US-West production environment. We have noticed that certain actions do not appear to be recorded. This is affecting a small group of about 17 users who are trying to track changes for internal review. I believe the Report Builder itself is failing to log these events correctly. Can you look into why the audit trail is incomplete?

final_diagnosis.recommended_next_action: Verify the configuration of the Audit Log Service and review the manual configuration change made on 2025-04-30 22:47:00.
final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The audit log gaps detected in the Report Builder tool are likely due to a configuration issue with the Audit Log Service, which is owned by the Compliance & Audit team. The evidence suggests that a manual configuration change was made on 2025-04-30 22:47:00, which may have caused the issue. Further investigation is needed to verify the configuration and determine the root cause of the problem.
